definition: [ בָּרַר ] verb purify, select (compare Assyrian barâru , be shining , in derivatives Zim BP 46. 73 Belser BAS ii. 154 ; Arabic pious, kind, true ; he was pious, good, virtuous, honest ) — Qal Perfect בָּרוֺתִי Ezek 20:38 Infinitive suffix לְבָרָם Eccl 3:18 , Ges «GKC:67»§ 67 R, 3; compare לָבוּר Eccl 9:1 (si vera lectio) as metaplastic form, but on text see בּוּר above; Participle passive masculine בָּרוּר Job 33:3 + 4 t.; feminine בְּרוּרָה Neh 5:18 ; Zeph 3:9 — 1. purge out, purify: וּבָרוֺתִי מִכֶּם הַמֹּרְדִים and I will purge out from among you the rebels Ezek 20:38 שָׂפָה בְּרוּרָה a purified lip Zeph 3:9 בָּרוּר מִלֵּל֑וּ utter in a pure, sincere manner Job 33:3 . 2. choose, select , only Participle and in Chronicler: chosen, valiant men 1Chr 7:40 porters 1Chr 9:22 musicians 1Chr 16:41 sheep Neh 5:18 . 3. cleanse, make shining, polish , passive participle חֵץ בָּרוּר polished arrow Isa 49:2 (compare De & Jer 51:11 below) 4. test, prove Eccl 3:18 לְבָרָם הָאֱלֹהִים that God may prove them ( RV ); — on Eccl 9:1 see בּוּר . Niph`al הִבָּרוּ Isa 52:11 Participle נָבָר 2Sam 22:27 (= Ps 18:27 ); — purify oneself: \ \ a. ceremonially, the bearers of the sacred vessels Isa 52:11 . \ \ b. morally 2Sam 22:27 = Ps 18:27 . Pi`el Infinitive לְבָרֵר Dan 11:35 purify (|| לִצְרוֺף , לַלְבֵּן ). Hiph`il 1. Infinitive לְהָבַר Jer 4:11 purify, cleanse. 2. Imperative הָבֵרוּ הַחִצִּים Jer 51:11 polish arrows (see 3 above). Hithpa`el 1. Imperfect יִתְבָּרֲרוּ Dan 12:10 purify oneself. 2. תִּתְבָּרַר Ps 18:27 = תִּתָּבָר 2Sam 22:27 shew oneself pure, just, kind.

\ \ a. ceremonially, the bearers of the sacred vessels Isa 52:11.
\ \ b. morally 2Sam 22:27 = Ps 18:27. Pi`el Infinitive לְבָרֵר Dan 11:35 purify (|| לִצְרוֺף, לַלְבֵּן).
Hiph`il 1. Infinitive לְהָבַר Jer 4:11 purify, cleanse.
2. Imperative הָבֵרוּ הַחִצִּים Jer 51:11 polish arrows (see 3 above).
Hithpa`el 1. Imperfect יִתְבָּרֲרוּ Dan 12:10 purify oneself.
2. תִּתְבָּרַר Ps 18:27 = תִּתָּבָר 2Sam 22:27 shew oneself pure, just, kind.
